name: tefillin_app
description: **Tefillin Mirror** is a real-time AI & Computer Vision web application designed to help Jewish users align their Head Tefillin (*Shel Rosh* / תפילין של ראש) with Halachic precision.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html style.css script.js tefillin_engine.js yolo_engine.js config.js www/ && cp -r i18n www/ && cp -r models www/ && if [ -d vendor ]; then cp -r vendor www/ && python3 -c "with open('www/index.html') as f: c=f.read(); c=c.replace('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/camera_utils/camera_utils.js', 'vendor/mediapipe/camera_utils.js').replace('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/face_mesh/face_mesh.js', 'vendor/mediapipe/face_mesh.js').replace('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort.min.js', 'vendor/onnx/ort.min.js'); open('www/index.html','w').write(c)"; fi
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
